shortDescription: Enable call home functionality by enabling remote connectivity service

options.name: access_key
options.description: the access key

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: appliance_id
options.description: The node appliance ID for ESE enablement of v3 API version

options.name: connection_type
options.description: The connection type of callhome, allowed values is DIRECT and GATEWAY

options.name: customer_contact_order
options.description: The contact order of customer

options.name: customer_email_address
options.description: The email address of customer

options.name: customer_first_name
options.description: The first name of customer

options.name: customer_last_name
options.description: The last name of customer

options.name: customer_phone_number
options.description: The phone_number of customer

options.name: customer_pref_language
options.description: The preferred language of customer

options.name: gateways_host
options.description: The host ip of gateways

options.name: gateways_port
options.description: The port of gateways

options.name: ip_version
options.description: IP version of remote connector. Allowed values are IPV4 and IPV6

options.name: pin
options.description: the PIN code

options.name: proxy_address
options.description: The address of proxy

options.name: proxy_passwd
options.description: The password for the user account provided in proxy

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of proxy

options.name: proxy_protocol
options.description: The protocol of proxy, allowed values is SOCK5, HTTP and HTTPS

options.name: proxy_type
options.description: The type of proxy, allowed values is USER,SYSTEM and NA

options.name: proxy_user
options.description: The user account of the proxy

options.name: serial_number
options.description: The node serial number for ESE enablement of both v1 and v2 API version

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for enabling callhome, the default value is 300 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
